label: Födelsestatus: net10-begränsad statusfördelning
purpose: Test whether Swedish-born/foreign-born population state adds useful compositional structure while preserving the validated production net10 migration total by sex and one-year age.

rules.totalNetMigration: Exactly the production net10 value for each geography, sex and one-year age cell.
rules.positiveNetAllocation: Allocate by each birth-status share of 10-year gross in-migration in the cell.
rules.negativeNetAllocation: Allocate by each birth-status share of 10-year gross out-migration in the cell.
rules.zeroEventFallback: Use the birth-status population share in the same sex-age cell over the same 10-year calibration window.
rules.mortality: Same production age-sex mortality risk for both birth statuses.
rules.stockConstraint: Negative migration cannot reduce a birth-status stock below zero; any unmet reduction is reassigned to the other status so the aggregate cell follows the production net10 target.

developmentEvaluation.structuralGate: Aggregate population and net migration must match the net10 baseline by year.
developmentEvaluation.governance: 2018-2024 results are development evidence only. No parameters or allocation rules may be changed after viewing these outcomes. Level 3 requires a newly locked external or future holdout.
